notes.title: Player Profile refresh. Team Roles and member promotions update.
notes.content: Player Profile refresh. Team Roles and member promotions update.

notes.title: Legends of Boom welcomes: Adam Koralic
notes.content:
Legends of Boom welcomes YouTuber, Adam Koralic to the show. You might hear from him, but if you want to get straight to it, try this code in chat: /guest 260007

https://www.youtube.com/user/AdamKoralik

notes.title: Team Update: Members can be promoted, and points can be assigned
notes.content: Team Leaders can now promote/demote team members. They can also assign/remove Team points.

notes.title: Legends of Boom welcomes John Hancock
notes.content:
Legends of Boom is happy to announce that prolific video game collector and lover of all things gaming, Mr. John Hancock, is making a guest appearance in game. You might see him from time to time if Flip gets bored and needs to check in on his weekly betting, or if you just want to see John Hancock and Flip have a nice conversation, use the chat code: 
/guest 260003

notes.title: Steam Achievements!
notes.content:
New: Achievements now in game. 
New: Players can change their name in Player Profile

notes.title: Big Weekly Update
notes.content:
New: Player Level-up sequence
Fixes: various UI fixes an improvements when spectating or playing in a 2v2 Match
Fix: AI will now play in the bottom row of the board
Prep: Adam Koralic
Prep: Steam Achievements
Lower: Chat costs
UI: Show Game Mode in pre-match screen
Perf: reduce "hitches" in gameplay from server events
Balance: Prefer AI closer in level to Players

notes.title: Deck building UI fix
notes.content:
Fix: AI Teammate in 2v2 won't try to use your nukes.
FIx: Bug where your deck wasn't complete but it showed a random card in the should-be-empty slot

notes.title: New: Tim Kitzrow announces some player's names
notes.content:
New: Now players who have played more than a week, and have reached level 5 or higher, have a chance of getting their custom name recordings (by Tim Kitzrow) added to the game. 

This week's winners: 007, Aaron, AnthoTheKID, Banditflask, boredLeo, Calactyte, Cdmpants, ChrisDeath555, Derrik, Digitalcity408, Gabe687, GeneralMalice, Hoop, Jenmurray00, LandolfTheGray, Ninja777JP, PeiperBot, PlanarKnight, Ryiah, Stevank318, Stranger, Stumpyzz, TheRealMsMalice

notes.title: Fix: Deck Building
notes.content: Fix: sometimes a deck wouldn't let you add a card unless you added it to the last spot in the deck

notes.title: New Gameplay Mode: 2v2!
notes.content: Play co-op vs 2 other players, in Daily Path of Boom quests, or in Quickmatch vs Players and/or AI

notes.title: Fix: Boom Box display
notes.content: Fixed a bug where Boom Boxes might not display properly, could blink, or just not show up.

notes.title: Leveling up now grants a free Pack of Cards
notes.content: Leveling up now grants a free Pack of Cards. Existing players were retroactively given packs as well. Enjoy!

notes.title: Spectate improvements. New visuals for Path of Boom.
notes.content:
New: Ability to hide UI during spectate
New: Path of Boom map GFX updates
New: Enhance Battle scene  VFX and Lighting
Fix: Battle Boost icons flickering.
Fix: Bug where weapon ghost could linger if destroyed by the exact amount of HP left.
Fix: Team tab is blank on first viewing.
Difficulty: Map 4 and 5 Bosses are less brutal

notes.title: Players can now send and receive Duel invites.
notes.content: Players can now send and receive Duel invites. Check the Comms screen.

notes.title: Lifetime Card Stats
notes.content:
New: Lifetime Card Stats show in Card Details window
Fix: Duel invite buttons now give feedback
Fix:Bug where you might not be able to place the last 2 cards on a small board

notes.title: Launch Update
notes.content:
Update: AI won't relentlessly call in Nuclear Strikes back-to-back
Fix: Chat icon for spectating a player's current Match
Nice: Players now get a free pack of cards if they are online during a server update
Fix: Players can now call in up to 3 Nuclear Strikes

notes.title: Spectator Mode fixes
notes.content: Fixes a soft-lock that can happen when spectating another player's game
